_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. Never commit real credentials. Live bidding stays OFF until live_bidding.configured is true AND you run with --live --confirm.

live_bidding.note: Set to true ONLY after registering a PropertyRoom account and putting a payment method on file. Even then, a bid needs --live --confirm on the command line. No account has been provided yet — do not invent one.

policy.tx_cap_note: PropertyRoom card/PayPal ceiling. At $5,000+ only wire transfer works; the agent never wires money on its own.

tax_rate_note: Sales tax is NOT printed on PropertyRoom lot pages. Set this to the ship-to jurisdiction's combined rate. 0.10 is the demo assumption (Lynnwood, WA ~10%). If null, the agent holds every lot for a human.
